products.title: The Essential Poplin Shirt - White
products.body_html:
To the untrained eye, this could look like a standard white shirt, but au contraire: this has actually been designed from scratch to be THE perfect oversized white shirt for year-round styling. Deep cuffs allow you to choose your sleeve length; side splits on each side allow for half-in-half-out styling that always looks good. And if that wasn't enough, the classic curved and bonded hem, oversized (but still flattering) fit and 100% organic cotton material allow you to wear and style this shirt 365 days a year. 

  • Deep cuff to add femininity 
  • TALA woven branded label on LHSAW cuff 
  • Centre front button closure 
  • Curved hem 
  • Side splits for multiway wearing 
  • Collar 
  • Consciously created with 100% Organic Cotton

Responsibility:

This item is made 100% Cotton Poplin  - cotton poplin is a durable lightweight cotton fabric and is less prone to creasing and organic cotton uses no chemicals, pesticides or fertilisers to produce

Certified by the Organic Content Standard  - Verified by ETC-OCS  that it has been produced in accordance with the Organic Farming Standard

Audited, Ethical Factories: Made in Turkey

Sedex-SMETA audited for worker health and safety. 

Oeko-Tex Standard 100 tested and certified for no harmful substances.

Read about our factories and fabrics here.

Correct at the time of publishing. 

Treat me with care... 

All TALA items are made to last. By caring for our clothes we prolong their life, so they can be worn, over and over again.

 Delicate machine wash at  30°C

Do not bleach

Do not tumble dry

Iron on a medium setting

Can be professionally dry cleaned

Can be steamed to remove creases
